# AI Sorix

> AI Sorix is the global zero-trust AI research ecosystem and workspace — 15+ frontier AI models, image generation, presentations, health & agriculture AI, and autonomous agents in one secure place.

AI Sorix gives individuals and teams a single workspace to chat with frontier AI models (GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Llama, Perplexity, Qwen, Mistral and more), generate images and presentations, analyze health and agriculture data, build flow diagrams, and run autonomous agents.
